issue.body:
In 0.10.0, the following code produces a comma-spacing error:

```
Math.min((2), 5);
```

This validates fine:

```
Math.min((2), (5));
```

This also throws the error, where as if you add parenthesis around the 2nd argument, it's OK again:

```
console.log((1), 2);
```

Not sure if the work being done in https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/610 will address this issue or not..
